request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:WORKSHOP

layers.text: Remove all ground: erase the grass and stone slab under the house, so the walls stand directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under them. Repaint the dark red dashes on the roof ridge and on the steel cogwheel in the same bright red as the roof or in steel grey. Keep the red roof, the big steel cogwheel, the timber-framed walls, workbench, outline and art style exactly the same.
